original_benchmark.notes: 100 expert prompts over professional PDFs in 10 domains, graded per rubric point by an LLM judge (gemini-3.5-flash). Surge's harness is an Inspect eval that sends the PDF to the model in one call and ships no agent. Surge's Hugging Face dataset is no longer public; the adapter uses the public copy cloudybean/GDP.pdf at revision 1b73b865.

harbor_adapter.notes: legal-03 is excluded because two of its rubric points contradict each other, so no answer can pass all of them. Parity ran on a 30-task subset (3 per domain, seed 0; `--split parity`), 3 runs per side. parity_costs is everything spent on parity with the 2077AI key (sanity checks, the stopped first run, the 3 runs and the cross-grading check), judge included; the 3 counted runs cost $55.72. The oracle re-run after the separate-grader change cost another $12.56 on the same key.
